name: Doing Gap
description: Takes stock of the courses and videos someone has worked through against what they have actually finished and released, then puts a name to whatever the next tutorial is helping them avoid. Suited to learners who suspect the problem is not knowledge, and blunt enough to be unwelcome otherwise.

official.title: Doing Gap by Sultanov
official.description: Workshop foreman for people stuck in tutorial hell. Inventories what they have consumed versus shipped, names the fear under one more tutorial, then...
